title: Simplify the website, clarify CLI access, and restyle the black hole
outcome: A concise landing page with a tilted luminous black hole inspired by the user's reference and clear, accurate MCP/CLI access in the website and root README.
acceptance: Focused website and CLI documentation validation passes across desktop/mobile; existing unrelated changes are preserved; no commit or push.
Hero uses a tilted pink/gold accretion disk with cyan jet inspired by the supplied reference, with accessible reduced-motion and pause behavior.
Landing page is materially simpler, with technical detail still reachable and capability/privacy limitations preserved.
Root README foregrounds verified CLI support with examples matching the implementation.

completion.summary: Promoted existing CLI support in README and landing page, simplified default content, and restyled hero as a tilted pink/gold black hole with cyan jets.
